summary: sw-pluginer fetches and eval()s remote JavaScript from an externally-planted manifest during Tailwind build
details: sw-pluginer@1.1.0 exports a Tailwind plugin that, when invoked during a Tailwind build, reads a URL from process.cwd()/node_modules/.bin/manifest.json, HTTP(S)-GETs the script at that URL, and passes the response body to eval(). The URL is unpinned and unauthenticated, and the fetched content is not integrity-checked. The manifest.json file is not owned by this package (its path under node_modules/.bin is atypical) and is unlinked after being read — a staging pattern consistent with a two-stage dropper where a sibling package plants the URL and this package resolves and executes it at build time. Loading the plugin causes arbitrary attacker-controlled JavaScript to run in the developer or CI build host's Node process, yielding remote code execution against the installer.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
